sv.title: Misstänkt utbrott av mässling i Stockholm
sv.summary: Hundratals personer ska testas för mässling i Stockholm efter ett misstänkt utbrott, rapporterar TV4. En smittad person ska ha befunnit sig på akutmottagningen på Södersjukhuset under flera timmar tillsammans med flera andra personer.

en.title: Suspected measles outbreak in Stockholm
en.summary: Hundreds of people are to be tested for measles in Stockholm after a suspected outbreak, reports TV4. An infected person is said to have spent several hours in the emergency department at Södersjukhuset together with several other people.
